parameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE independently new full-body 08 alchemy prodigy boy walking sprite on a true transparent square canvas, native at least 1024x1024. Image1 is the primary SE standing pose, camera, proportions, costume and equipment anchor; image2 is original identity; image3 is only painted material/style, never draw its UI. Preserve Image1 exactly: rounded amber-eyed child face and chestnut high topknot with jade/gold clasp and two gold ribbons, orange-gold brocade robe with teal panels, ivory puffy trousers, green-gold boots with ivory toe caps, strapped herb basket with twin ivory scrolls, beads/pouch/tassels. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the bronze-jade yin-yang censer on the NEAR arm on screen LEFT; LEFT hand holds potion on the FAR arm on screen RIGHT. Never switch hands or mirror the character. Same fixed slight top-down camera and SOUTH-EAST three-quarter FRONT view, face/torso/both boots directed down-right, arms quietly hold equipment. Keep original head/body size and short stout limbs, balanced gentle normal walking with a short stride, not marching, running, kicking, jumping or high knees. Most boot uppers visible; do not point a broad sole toward viewer. Preserve subject size and fixed ground origin, around84% canvas height, grounded sole y92%, safe empty margins. Redraw legs and corresponding cloth for this exact gait phase; do not reuse or shift an idle pose. Bright clean polished hand-painted Daoist chibi materials. Transparent alpha; no scenery, floor, shadow, halo, colored fringe, text, grid, labels, duplicate characters or sheet. Image4 is the leg identity/proportion anchor; redraw the exact changed phase. Frame05 compact RIGHT PASSING. Keep FAR LEFT foot/potion-side on ground at lower-right x63% y94%, directly supporting pelvis. NEAR RIGHT leg/censer-side is the swing leg: its bent knee comes alongside left knee, and its boot is lifted ONLY to the height of the standing left ankle, close beside it at x54% y89-90%. Right boot upper/toecap visible, toes point gently down-right, almost no sole visible. The two boots must be close side-by-side during passage, not a wide forward/rear stride. Right knee must not lift high. Stable upper body; actual one-foot support. This is a quiet WALK passing pose.
